mapper.insert: insert into PBC_INIT_PROD_RAISING_SUB (REGIST_SEQNO, PBC_PROD_ID, BUY_PLACE, CUSTOMER_TYPE1, CCY, INIT_RAISING_AMTSUM, INIT_RAISING_AMTSUMCNY, INIT_RAISING_QTY, SEND_STATUS, SUBMIT_TIME, SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS, SUMIT_SEQ, STATUS_DATE, PBC_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, SUBMIT_DEADLINE, STATUS, CREATE_USER, ORG_CODE, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{registSeqno,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{pbcProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{buyPlace,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{customerType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ccy,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{initRaisingAmtsum,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{initRaisingAmtsumcny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{initRaisingQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{submitTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{submitFeedbackStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sumitSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{pbcSubmitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{submitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT pos.CDATE, pos.PROD_ID, pos.CCY, sum(ifnull(pos.BALANCE_QTY,0)) BALANCE_QTY, sum(ifnull(pos.BALANCE_AMT,0)) BALANCE_AMT, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2 FROM CHB_PRD_POSITION pos left join chb_prd_baseinfo info on info.prod_id = pos.prod_id and info.status != 'D' and info.fprod_id is null left join chb_prd_baseinfo finfo on finfo.prod_id = pos.prod_id and finfo.status != 'D' and info.fprod_id is not null where 1=1
select #{sub.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},DATE_FORMAT(#{sub.vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') from dual
group by pos.CDATE,pos.PROD_ID,pos.CCY,pos.BUY_PLACE,pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2

SELECT STR_TO_DATE(pos.DEALDATE ,'yyyyMMdd') CDATE, pos.FINPROD_ID PROD_ID, pos.CCY, sum(ifnull(pos.PRINQTY,0)) BALANCE_QTY, sum(ifnull(pos.DEALAMT,0)) BALANCE_AMT, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2 FROM P_INTERF_PRO_CUSTOM_DEAL pos where 1=1 and pos.DEALTYPE='1' and (pos.BUY_PLACE not in('210200','330200','350200','370200','440300') or pos.BUY_PLACE is null)
select #{sub.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},DATE_FORMAT(#{sub.vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyyMMdd') from dual
group by pos.DEALDATE, pos.FINPROD_ID, pos.CCY, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2

with tab as ( select * from ( select concat_ws('','buyplace', a.CUSTOMER_TYPE1,a.BUY_PLACE) code, list.ITEM_VALUE,a.BUY_PLACE,a.CUSTOMER_TYPE1, a.INIT_RAISING_AMTSUM rmbje, a.INIT_RAISING_QTY rmbfe, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.pbc_prod_id,a.BUY_PLACE,a.CUSTOMER_TYPE1,a.CCY ORDER BY ifnull(a.STATUS_DATE,a.CREATE_TIME) DESC) RANKNUM from PBC_INIT_PROD_RAISING_SUB a LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST list ON a.CCY=list.ITEM_CODE and list.DICT_CODE='CURRENCY_CHB' where a.pbc_prod_id= #{pbcProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )t where t.RANKNUM=1 ) union all select 'buyplace4000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='4' union all select 'buyplace5000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='5' union all select 'buyplace6000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='6' union all select 'buyplace7000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='7' union all select 'buyplace8000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='8' union all select 'buyplace9000000',sum(rmbje),sum(rmbfe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='9'

WITH tab as (select * from ( select concat_ws('','buyplace', a.CUSTOMER_TYPE1,a.BUY_PLACE) code, list.ITEM_VALUE,a.BUY_PLACE,a.CUSTOMER_TYPE1, a.INIT_RAISING_AMTSUM je,a.INIT_RAISING_AMTSUMCNY zrmb,a.INIT_RAISING_QTY fe, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.pbc_prod_id,a.BUY_PLACE,a.CUSTOMER_TYPE1,a.CCY ORDER BY ifnull(a.STATUS_DATE,a.CREATE_TIME) DESC) RANKNUM from PBC_INIT_PROD_RAISING_SUB a LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST list ON a.CCY=list.ITEM_CODE and list.DICT_CODE='CURRENCY_CHB' where a.pbc_prod_id= #{pbcProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )t where t.RANKNUM=1 ) SELECT tab.code,tab.ITEM_VALUE,tab.je,tab.zrmb,tab.fe from tab union all select 'buyplace4000000',tab.ITEM_VALUE,sum(je),sum(zrmb),sum(fe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='4' group by tab.ITEM_VALUE union all select 'buyplace5000000',tab.ITEM_VALUE,sum(je),sum(zrmb),sum(fe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='5' group by tab.ITEM_VALUE union all select 'buyplace6000000',tab.ITEM_VALUE,sum(je),sum(zrmb),sum(fe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='6' group by tab.ITEM_VALUE union all select 'buyplace7000000',tab.ITEM_VALUE,sum(je),sum(zrmb),sum(fe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='7' group by tab.ITEM_VALUE union all select 'buyplace8000000',tab.ITEM_VALUE,sum(je),sum(zrmb),sum(fe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='8' group by tab.ITEM_VALUE union all select 'buyplace9000000',tab.ITEM_VALUE,sum(je),sum(zrmb),sum(fe) from tab WHERE tab.CUSTOMER_TYPE1='9' group by tab.ITEM_VALUE
